versions.changelog: v2.3 quality enhancement - security audit + marketing packaging + slug-content validation

Initial release of ComfyUI Painter LITE – a free, local image generation tool powered by ComfyUI.

- Supports text-to-image generation via a local GPU using ComfyUI API.
- Manual parameter control enabled (steps, CFG, sampler, etc); does not include CivitAI integration or automatic parameter tuning.
- Includes management scripts for starting/stopping ComfyUI, status checks, and auto-shutdown when idle.
- Preconfigured with three model aliases covering anime and photorealistic styles.
- Basic error handling and guideline documentation provided for troubleshooting and optimal use.
